title: Vapor pressures of binary aqueous solutions of NaCl, KCl, Na2SO4 and MgSO4 at concentrations and temperatures of interest in desalination processes
experimental_method: Differential vapour pressure of solution against pure water in glass isoteniscopes (Smith-Menzies type) in an oil thermostat at 75, 100, 125, 150 C, read on a two-metre mercury manometer with a cathetometer; solutions degassed by freeze-thaw cycles.
uncertainties_stated: Precision of the measurements 0.1 per cent of the measured vapour pressure (summary); thermostat control +/-0.005 C; standard deviation of experiment versus the authors' correlation: NaCl 0.08%, KCl 0.15%, Na2SO4 0.11%, MgSO4 0.03% (in aw).
quality_remarks: Only the water activity aw = p/p0 is tabulated (vapour pressures themselves are not). Concentrations corrected by the authors for water evaporated in the isoteniscope; aw corrected for water-vapour non-ideality at high T. Misprints in the printed tables, kept as printed: Table II 150 C first m 0.95083 (probably 0.05083); Table IV 150 C last (aw)calc. 0.8988 (probably 0.9988). The Table III 75 C first row aw exp 0.9976 is higher than aw calc 0.9956 and than the 100 C value; kept. Molality unit not printed in the table headers (inferred from the symbol list). The 'S. D.' lines printed under the 150 C block are not data rows.
